overlap.rationale_zh: 与 1.1.1 血压核心项为同一指标；试验为随机分组，未对其他项做校正，按规则系数压到 0.3

transport.ancestry: international (mostly Europe, North America, Asia trials)

population.cohort: 123 randomised trials of blood pressure lowering

evidence.quote: Every 10 mm Hg reduction in systolic blood pressure significantly reduced the risk of major cardiovascular disease events (relative risk [RR] 0·80, 95% CI 0·77-0·83), coronary heart disease (0·83, 0·78-0·88), stroke (0·73, 0·68-0·77), and heart failure (0·72, 0·67-0·78), which, in the populations studied, led to a significant 13% reduction in all-cause mortality (0·87, 0·84-0·91).
evidence.estimand_zh: 随机对照试验荟萃的因果估计：降压治疗使收缩压每降低 10 mmHg 的全因死亡相对危险 0.87，按原文'每降低'取倒数（pow -1）得每升高 10 mmHg 的 HR；是治疗性降压的效应，不是自然分布暴露的观察性 HR。东亚队列研究（PMID 29304766 等）只给分类 HR，不能折成斜率，故未选
